advisory.title: Crafted ZIP file triggers excessive memory allocation

scope.permittedEnvironment: isolated developer or CI build workspace with locked dependencies

mandatoryControls: production-only npm audit must report zero vulnerabilities at high or critical severity
full npm audit may contain only the exact advisory graph listed in this policy
Hardhat must not process user-uploaded or otherwise untrusted ZIP archives
generated artifacts must remain ignored build outputs and must be regenerated from tracked Solidity sources
contract-tooling-check and full Go tests must pass after dependency installation
the exception expires automatically and must not be extended without a new evidence record
Security/SRE must accept, replace or reject this exception before production release
exitConditions: a compatible fixed adm-zip release is available and verified
the contract toolchain is replaced by an audited compiler path
